# @mgpl-diagnostics/security-kit

> Security primitives for both sides of MGPL Diagnostics, with zero dependencies. The browser entry collects device signals (device id, tab id, coarse fingerprint, device info) in any frontend and sends them as the x-mgpl-signals header; the server entry validates them, binds them to a session (hashed ids) and checks later requests (same / changed / other-device / missing / unbound). The server entry also has clientIp behind proxies, security and CORS headers, and log redaction.

Key facts for agents:
- Works with any library: browser adapters signalFetch, mergeSignalHeaders, axiosSignals, kySignals, apolloSignals, signalStore, and collector.subscribe/getSnapshot; "./react" useDeviceSignals; server adapters requestSecurity, fetchSecurity, expressSecurity, fastifySecurity. No adapter imports its library.
- Entries: "." (shared: types, encode/decode, randomId, sha256Hex, constantTimeEqual), "./browser" (createSignalCollector, deviceInfo, storages), "./server" (readSignals, bindSignals, checkSignals, decide, clientIp, readTlsFingerprint, securityHeaders, corsPolicy, redact, maskEmail, maskPhone).
- The shared and browser parts use no Node.js APIs (checked by typecheck and scripts/check-dist.mjs).
- decodeSignals / readSignals never throw and return null for anything malformed or oversized.
- readTlsFingerprint reads a JA4/JA3 TLS fingerprint from a header the TLS-terminating proxy sets, only when trustedHops >= 1 and a header name is configured (same trust model as X-Forwarded-For); null otherwise, never throws.
- Token and session logic stays in auth-kit; security-kit only supplies signals and helpers.

## Source

- [src/shared/signals.ts](src/shared/signals.ts): encode, decode and validate signals
- [src/browser/collect.ts](src/browser/collect.ts): createSignalCollector
- [src/browser/adapters.ts](src/browser/adapters.ts): fetch, axios, ky, Apollo, store adapters
- [src/react.ts](src/react.ts): useDeviceSignals
- [src/server/adapters.ts](src/server/adapters.ts): Express, Fastify, Fetch adapters
- [src/browser/device.ts](src/browser/device.ts): device info and fingerprint inputs
- [src/server/signals.ts](src/server/signals.ts): readSignals, bindSignals, checkSignals, decide
- [src/server/ip.ts](src/server/ip.ts): clientIp
- [src/server/tls.ts](src/server/tls.ts): readTlsFingerprint, parseTlsFingerprint
- [src/server/headers.ts](src/server/headers.ts): securityHeaders, corsPolicy
- [src/server/redact.ts](src/server/redact.ts): redact, maskEmail, maskPhone
- [scripts/test.ts](scripts/test.ts): all checks
